channel.title: Mitanshu Sukhwani's Blog
channel.description: Hello, I’m Mitanshu Sukhwani, creator of PaperMatch with a Master’s in Physics from IIT Madras. I’ve worked at IISER Tirupati on EEG data, network science, and brain modeling. I enjoy exploring ML, Linux, and the intersection of neuroscience, software, and data.

item.title: "About Jellyfin"
item.description: "This blog post describes about jellyfin, a self hosted streaming platform"
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Autoconnect to ProtonVPN using systemd"
item.description: "This blog post describes a method to autostart ProtonVPN client using the systemd service"
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Automate with Ansible"
item.description: "Automate system management with Ansible using Playbooks to define desired states. Learn installation, idempotent tasks, and secure automation with Vault. Based on tutorials from LearnLinuxTV."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Behind PaperMatch"
item.description: "How I built PaperMatch: a paper recommendation engine using arXiv abstracts, transformer embeddings, and Milvus. Learn about the embedding pipeline, vector search, and Gradio-powered UI at papermatch.me."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Behind PaperMatchBio"
item.description: "How I extended PaperMatch to bioRxiv: mining full-text XMLs from AWS S3, extracting metadata, embedding abstracts, and uploading everything to Hugging Face Datasets. Includes code for downloading, parsing, and vectorizing bioRxiv preprints."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Books Read"
item.description: "A personal reading list spanning memoirs, fiction, science, and philosophy — from 'Sapiens' and 'Educated' to 'The Martian' and 'Thinking, Fast and Slow'. A mix of thought-provoking, entertaining, and reflective reads remembered from memory."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Browse Intranet from Home"
item.description: "Guide to securely access the IISER Tirupati intranet from home using Tailscale VPN and sshuttle. Works with a campus-connected workstation and a Linux/Mac device with sudo access. Quick setup for remote intranet browsing."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Create a simple website"
item.description: "Step-by-step guide to build a free personal website using GitHub Pages and Markdown. Convert your content with Pandoc and publish easily without writing raw HTML. Ideal for developers and writers familiar with git."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Filter Coffee Recipe"
item.description: "The author lists their recipe for filter coffee."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "How to Install Cloudflared on Alpine"
item.description: "Guide to install and run Cloudflared on Alpine Linux for Raspberry Pi Zero 2W using OpenRC. Includes tunnel setup, systemd replacement with OpenRC, and startup configuration."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "How to SSH to another user"
item.description: "Learn how to copy your SSH public key to another user on the same system using sudo. Includes manual steps and a shell script to automate directory setup, permission handling, and key transfer for passwordless SSH access"
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "How to change SSH Port on OCI"
item.description: "Guide to securely change the SSH port on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Includes SELinux adjustments, firewall and security list updates, and troubleshooting via Cloud Shell."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "How to copy ssh keys from master to compute node"
item.description: "Quick guide to set up passwordless SSH access from the master to compute nodes in an HPC cluster. Covers key generation, retrieving node IPs, and using ssh-copy-id."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "How to fix Tablet app Orientations"
item.description: "Force portrait-locked apps like Venmo or Authy to run in landscape on Android tablets and foldables using a simple ADB command. Works on Android 12+ with letterboxing support."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "How to run Jupyter on compute node"
item.description: "Step-by-step guide to run JupyterLab on HPC compute nodes at IISER Tirupati, using or bypassing PBS. Includes SSH tunneling setup, port forwarding, and automated scripts for seamless access from local machine."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "How to run Tailscale without root"
item.description: "Learn how to set up and run Tailscale in user-space without root access. Includes steps for downloading static binaries, configuring tailscaled with a custom socket and port, automating startup via cron, and troubleshooting multi-user setups."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "IsOddApi"
item.description: "A playful REST API that tells you if a number is odd—powered by isEven API under the hood and built with Flask and Docker. Visit isodd.papermatch.me for docs, source code, and usage examples."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Masala Tea Recipe"
item.description: "A simple, personal masala chai recipe using Taj Mahal Tea, Everest Tea Masala, and full cream milk. Steep, boil, strain, and enjoy this aromatic Indian classic. Sweetener optional, but sugar tastes best!"
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Milvus on Podman"
item.description: "Guide to running Milvus using Podman instead of Docker by modifying Milvus's official standalone script. Adjustments include removing sudo, adding SELinux ':Z' flags for volume mounts, and using fully qualified image names for compatibility."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "N-gram Language Models"
item.description: "Explore the basics of N-gram models—simple yet powerful tools in NLP—through a hands-on bigram generator built on Jane Austen's 'Pride and Prejudice'. A look back at language modeling before the LLM era."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "On Frugality"
item.description: "How being frugal beyond a limit is detrimental"
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "PaperMatch Analysis"
item.description: "Exploring how vector embeddings reveal insights about scientific research on arXiv. From distance metrics and vector DB performance to category shifts and dimensionality reduction using PCA, UMAP, and MRL on millions of abstracts."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Project Wishlist"
item.description: "A wishlist of personal tech projects—from building a silent trimmer for sensory sensitivity to syncing BeanConqueror with NextCloud, making a OnePlus pencil work with a phone, and running DuckDB on Kindle."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "SSH into Android with Termux & Cloudflared"
item.description: "Learn how to set up secure SSH access to your Android device using Termux and Cloudflare Tunnels. Complete guide covering installation, configuration, and browser-based terminal access from anywhere in the world."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Selfhosting Setup"
item.description: "A personal journey into selfhosting—repurposing old hardware, running Debian with Docker, and hosting Nextcloud & Audiobookshelf using Cloudflare Tunnel and Tailscale to own your data and reduce reliance on Big Tech."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Setup Nebula"
item.description: "Learn how to self-host a mesh VPN using Nebula, the open-source Tailscale alternative. Set up a lighthouse node on Google Cloud’s free tier, configure firewall rules, and connect devices securely."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Stop podman containers from getting killed"
item.description: "Keep rootless Podman containers running after logout or reboot using systemd user services, linger sessions, and generated unit files. Note: systemd support is deprecated; consider using Quadlets."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Tailscale on Kindle"
item.description: "Guide to running Tailscale on a jailbroken Kindle using KUAL and USBNetworking. Includes setup steps, binary placement, login, and remote SSH access via Tailscale IP."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Ultimate Coffee Recipes"
item.description: "Brew like a pro with James Hoffmann’s top techniques for V60, Chemex, AeroPress, French Press, and more. Includes links to brewers and a curated YouTube playlist."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Update podman containers manually"
item.description: "Manually update Podman containers by stopping them, pulling new images, restarting with original commands, and regenerating systemd service files if auto-update isn't working."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "WSA with KernelSU"
item.description: "Run rooted Android on Windows using WSA with KernelSU. Includes Google Play, sideloading, ZygiskNext, LSPosed, and Pixelify to unlock unlimited Google Photos storage."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Wash your Cocktails"
item.description: "Make a clarified coffee cocktail using milk washing. Infuse vodka with coffee and masala, curdle with milk and lemon, filter slowly, and enjoy a smooth, flavorful punch—budget-friendly and delicious."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "What about the Island?"
item.description: "A mysterious cluster of arXiv papers formed a new 'island' in UMAP projections between Nov 2024–Feb 2025. Data suggests a systemic shift—was it aliens or just arXiv changing something?"
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "Where's the human touch?"
item.description: "The author lists their experience on how LLMs are taking away the human connection."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)

item.title: "How to register (any*) passkey to linux?"
item.description: "Register a new device on linux using command line and authenticate with a touch."
item.author: mitanshu.sukhwani@gmail.com (Mitanshu Sukhwani)
